description: A masterizer, which passes its polyphonic input to its output unchanged.

params.text: A two-position switch marked On and More On; nothing in the module reads it beyond the rate at which the button's light pulses, and neither position changes the signal.

inputs.text: The polyphonic signal passed to the output.

outputs.text: Carries the input unchanged, with the same number of channels.

menu: Visuals — a submenu of Blue, Dark and Light for the colour scheme, plus Flat for a look without the 3D shading. The choice covers every SubmarineFree module and is kept outside the patch.
